packageRules.description: Cluster infra: one PR per package, never automerge.
Charts that must be upgraded one minor at a time get one PR per minor (Cilium, Longhorn, cert-manager, CNPG).
Flux components are versioned by the flux2 manager only, so the kubernetes manager doesn't open duplicate PRs for gotk-components.
Apps: minor and patch updates are grouped and automerged. The repo has no CI, so ignoreTests stops Renovate waiting for status checks that will never arrive.

...except where 'minor' can still break things: 0.x versions (a minor bump there is effectively a major) and stateful datastores with on-disk formats. On 2026-10-31 immich chart 0.10→0.13 and meilisearch 1.48→1.56 were automerged and broke.
